posts.author: Sandra Serag
posts.content:
We Are Hiring: MIS Executive | Al Ain

We are currently looking for an experienced MIS Executive to join our team in Dubai.

Requirements:
-Minimum 2 years of experience in MIS, Data Analysis, Reporting, or a similar role.
-Bilingual in Arabic and English is a MUST.
-Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query, Dashboards).
-Experience in data management, reporting, and performance tracking.
-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
-Ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
-Experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is an added advantage.
-Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
-Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Location: Al Ain

ONLY APPLICATIONS IN UAE WILL BE CONSIDERED

If you meet the above criteria and are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to: sandramohamed.serag@teleperformance.com

Kindly note that if you are not contacted, your application has not passed the CV screening process.
